name: Home First Finance Company India Ltd

ledger.quote: Our disbursal guidance for FY26 remains in the range of Rs. 5,600-5,800 Cr.
ledger.speaker: Manoj Viswanathan
ledger.verdict: FY26 has ended and management did not state full-year disbursement numbers on the call.

ledger.quote: We intend to add 6 new branches in Q2.
ledger.speaker: Manoj Viswanathan
ledger.verdict: Management did not report Q2 FY26 branch addition results on the latest call.

ledger.quote: We continue to maintain a credit cost guidance of 30 to 40 bps, ensuring disciplined risk management even as we scale.
ledger.speaker: Manoj Viswanathan
ledger.verdict: Management did not disclose the full-year FY26 credit cost on the latest call.

ledger.quote: We expect this ratio to remain range bound within 2.6% - 2.7% as we focus on growth and expansion.
ledger.speaker: Nutan Gaba Patwari
ledger.verdict: Full-year FY26 operating cost to assets ratio was not reported on the call.

ledger.quote: We aim to take co-lending contribution to 10% of disbursements as we scale.
ledger.speaker: Nutan Gaba Patwari
ledger.verdict: Co-lending disbursements reached Rs 46 crore, forming 2.8% of Q1 FY27 total disbursements.
ledger.evidence: Co-lending disbursements were INR46 crore, taking co-lending book to INR617 crore, 3.6% of the AUM.

ledger.quote: We aim to deliver 15% ROE in the next five to six quarters and then build from there.
ledger.speaker: Nutan Gaba Patwari
ledger.verdict: ROE reached 14.5% in Q1 FY27, tracking toward the 15% target.
ledger.evidence: Profit after tax increased by 7.0% sequentially and 34.5% year-on-year to INR160 crore, supported by 38.2% growth in Net Interest Income. Return on Assets improved by 10 basis points sequentially to 4.2%, while Return on Equity improved by 50 basis points to 14.5%.

ledger.quote: We plan to add four to five new branches in the upcoming quarter.
ledger.speaker: Manoj Viswanathan
ledger.verdict: Branch additions for the upcoming quarter mentioned in November 2025 were not reported.

ledger.quote: We are aiming to get it under 8%, let us say, by March.
ledger.speaker: Nutan Gaba Patwari
ledger.verdict: Cost of borrowing reduced to 7.8% in Q1 FY27, achieving the sub-8% target.
ledger.evidence: On the liability side, proactive management of our borrowing mix led to a further 10 basis point sequential reduction, bringing cost of borrowing down to 7.8%.

ledger.quote: We have 6-8 branches in the pipeline and at least 6 branches will be added in Q4.
ledger.speaker: Manoj Viswanathan
ledger.target: Add at least 6 branches in Q4
ledger.verdict: Management did not confirm if at least six branches were added in Q4 FY26.

ledger.quote: As we move toward FY27, we are positioned to achieve 25% AUM growth driven by enhanced distribution
ledger.speaker: Manoj Viswanathan
ledger.verdict: AUM grew 25.7% YoY in Q1 FY27 to Rs 16,938 crore, matching target.
ledger.evidence: AUM stood at INR16,938 crore as of Jun'26, growing 25.7% year-on-year and 6.7% sequentially.

ledger.quote: We aim to take co-lending contribution to 10% of AUM as we scale.
ledger.speaker: Nutan Gaba Patwari
ledger.verdict: Co-lending book reached Rs 617 crore, representing 3.6% of total AUM.
ledger.evidence: Co-lending disbursements were INR46 crore, taking co-lending book to INR617 crore, 3.6% of the AUM.

ledger.quote: FY27, again, we are looking to add about 25-30 branches.
ledger.speaker: Manoj Viswanathan
ledger.verdict: Management added four branches in Q1 FY27 toward its full-year target of 25-30.
ledger.evidence: during the quarter, we added four branches, one each in Gujarat, Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu and Madhya Pradesh, taking our network to 175 branches and 373 touch points.

ledger.quote: That will be in the region of around 20%-23% AUM growth Y-o-Y if we have to get to Rs. 35,000 crores.
ledger.speaker: Manoj Viswanathan
ledger.verdict: Long-term goal of reaching Rs 35,000 crore AUM by 2030 remains pending.
ledger.evidence: We remain confident of delivering 25% AUM growth while maintaining our focus on profitability, portfolio quality and operating efficiency.

ledger.quote: Our aim remains to deliver a spread at a portfolio level in our guided range of 5% to 5.25%.
ledger.speaker: Nutan Gaba Patwari
ledger.verdict: Spread excluding co-lending was 5.3% in Q1 FY27 against 5%-5.25% target.
ledger.evidence: We are committed to maintaining that 5% to 5.25% basis points spread.

ledger.quote: Guidance on the credit cost is the same.  30bps to 40bps.
ledger.speaker: Manoj Viswanathan
ledger.verdict: Credit cost was 40 bps in Q1 FY27, sitting within guided range.
ledger.evidence: Credit cost for Q1 was 40 basis points. Provision coverage on Stage 3 assets was 23.4% as of Jun'26 compared to 23.9% in Q4FY26.

open.quote: We remain confident of delivering 25% AUM growth while maintaining our focus on profitability, portfolio quality and operating efficiency.
open.speaker: Manoj Viswanathan

open.quote: As we continue to invest for growth, we expect this ratio to broadly remain range bound within 2.6%, 2.7%.
open.speaker: Nutan Patwari

read: There is too little settled yet to judge management's track record as only one promise has matured and been kept. FY27 targets on 25% AUM growth, 15% ROE, and branch additions fall due next.
questions: What were the actual full-year FY26 total disbursements and credit cost figures relative to initial guidance?
Did the company achieve its operating expenses to assets target of 2.6%-2.7% for full-year FY26?
How many net branches were added in Q4 FY26 against the guided target of at least six?
bull: Cost of borrowing reduced to 7.8% in Q1 FY27, achieving management's sub-8% guidance.
AUM grew 25.7% YoY in Q1 FY27 to Rs 16,938 crore, matching 25% growth target.
Q1 FY27 PAT grew 34.5% YoY to Rs 160 crore while ROE reached 14.5%.
bear: Reported operating cost to assets of 2.8% in Q1 FY27 exceeded the guided 2.6%-2.7% range.
Co-lending book stands at 3.6% of AUM, remaining behind the target of 10%.
Gross Stage 3 assets remained flat at 1.8% while credit cost touched 40 bps limit.
